story.titleZh: 拉塞尔巴库杆位到冠军：「感觉又找回了自己」，余下赛季目标「每场都赢」
story.summaryZh: 拉塞尔在巴库包揽周四练习最快、杆位和正赛冠军，把与队友安东内利的积分差距从81分缩小到66分。这是他自6月奥地利站以来的首个分站冠军、本季第3胜，而安东内利目前已赢8场。谈到信心回归，他说是对新采用的驾驶风格积累了更多经验：「夏休之后每一站我都觉得越来越强，感觉又更像自己了。」（来源：Formula 1）
story.originalTitle: George Russell ‘feels like myself again’ after ‘incredible’ pole-to-victory drive in Azerbaijan
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔周六在巴库城市赛道顶住了马克斯·维斯塔潘的猛烈追击，拿下个人2026赛季第三场胜利。
乔治·拉塞尔盛赞自己在阿塞拜疆度过了一个从头到尾都「不可思议」的周末：这位梅赛德斯车手在周四练习中排名第一，以统治级表现夺得杆位，最终拿下胜利，并借此把队友基米·安东内利在车手积分榜上的领先优势削减了15分。
拉塞尔来到本站时落后安东内利81分，他在冲向方格旗的较量中力压红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘，把差距缩小到66分；而这位年轻的意大利车手在第一节排位发生戏剧性事故后，正赛从第16位追到了第五。
这是拉塞尔自6月奥地利站以来的首个分站冠军，也是他2026赛季迄今的第三胜，而安东内利目前已经赢了8场。
「重回领奖台最高处的感觉太棒了，」拉塞尔赛后说，「我只想特别感谢我的车队，他们在艰难时刻一直相信我，帮我挺了过来。我为这个周末感到非常自豪。
「比赛前半段感觉相当顺利，一直在拉开差距，然后是安全车重启……当我看到马克斯在身后，我就想『这不会轻松』。他在比赛最后阶段开得非常出色。
「黄旗出来的时候（因为瓦尔特利·博塔斯撞车），我收了油，等我再踩下去时没有涡轮，所以也就没有动力。马克斯差点在终点线上超过我，那样就太可惜了。总的来说，这是一个不可思议的周末。」
被问到信心似乎已经回来时，拉塞尔补充说：「我想只是对我采用的这种新驾驶风格有了更多经验。夏休之后的每一场比赛，我都觉得自己越来越强。我感觉又更像我自己了，这真的很棒。」
至于在剩余分站中如何追赶安东内利，这位英国车手明确表达了自己的意图。
「每场都赢！这就是计划。」他笑着说，「我的队友这个赛季表现不可思议，几乎一直无懈可击，但现在到了关键时刻。
「我只会专注于自己。如果我能继续像这个周末一样发挥，无论赛季末发生什么，我都会很开心。这段时间对我来说非常艰难，现在我感觉自己已经走出来了。」
（来源：Formula 1 官网）
detailEn: George Russell fended off a charging Max Verstappen to claim his third victory of the 2026 season at the Baku City Circuit on Saturday.

George Russell hailed an “incredible” weekend from start to finish in Azerbaijan, with the Mercedes driver topping Thursday practice, charging to a dominant pole and ultimately securing victory – cutting team mate Kimi Antonelli’s championship lead by 15 points in the process.

Russell headed into the event 81 points behind Antonelli, but trimmed that gap to 66 by edging out Red Bull’s Max Verstappen in a dash to the chequered flag, while the young Italian recovered from 16th to fifth after a dramatic Q1 accident.
It marks Russell’s first Grand Prix victory since Austria in June, and his third of the 2026 season so far, comparing to the eight Antonelli has achieved up to this point.

“It’s amazing to be back on the top step of the podium,” Russell commented post-race. “I just want to say a big thanks to my team, because they continued to believe in me through tough moments, helped me come through it. I’m really proud to have had this weekend.

“The first half of the race felt pretty plain sailing, getting the gap, the Safety Car restart… When I saw Max behind, I thought, ‘It’s not going to be easy’. He drove incredibly at the end of the race.

“When the yellow flag came out [for Valtteri Bottas’ crash], I lifted off the power, and when I went back, I had no turbo, so then I had no power. Max almost got me at the line, so that would have been a real shame. All in all, an incredible weekend.”

Asked about his confidence seemingly returning, Russell added: “I think it’s just having more experience with this sort of new driving style that I’ve adopted. Every race since the [summer] break I feel like I’ve gone from strength to strength. I feel like more myself again, so that’s really great.”
As for how he plans to approach the remaining rounds of the championship, in his quest to overhaul Antonelli, the Briton made his intentions clear.
“Win every race! That’s the game plan,” he stated with a smile. “My team mate’s had an incredible season, he’s been pretty flawless throughout, but now we’re getting to crunch time.

“I’m just going to focus on myself. If I continue delivering performances like I’ve done this weekend, no matter what happens towards the end of the season, I’ll be happy. It’s been a really tough period for me, and now I feel like I’ve come through the other side.”

Source: Formula 1 (formula1.com). Original article: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/russell-feels-like-myself-again-after-incredible-pole-to-victory-drive-in-azerbaijan.67QSi4tYiFh9PYkG2KSgIY

relatedItems.originalTitle: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.

keyPointsEn: Leclerc could not overtake Hamilton due to track limits transgressions
